title: Updating the input pointer
statement: For any register state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $0$ of its register-value vector by $z$ yields the register-value vector of the state obtained by replacing its input pointer by $z$.
replaced:
Let $σ$ be a record of fifteen natural-number registers, and let $R(σ)$ list its
registers in order, with the input pointer first. Replacing coordinate $0$ of $R(σ)$ by
$z$ gives the register vector of the record obtained from $σ$ by replacing its input
pointer by $z$.
